title: Coupled oscillators
tagline: Several masses joined by springs: energy travels and normal modes appear.

block1.title: Block 1
block1.desc: Its mass m₁ is its inertia. The two springs touching it pull according to how much they stretch; that is how motion passes to its neighbours.

block2.title: Block 2
block2.desc: Its mass m₂ is its inertia. The two springs touching it pull according to how much they stretch; that is how motion passes to its neighbours.

spring1.title: Spring 1
spring1.desc: Constant k₁. Its force depends on the difference between the displacements of its ends: it is what couples the blocks.

wall.title: Walls
wall.desc: The fixed ends of the chain: the outer springs are anchored to them.

velocity.title: Velocity
velocity.desc: Each arrow shows its block's velocity. While paused, drag its tip to choose v₀.

presetInfo.mode: Starts exactly in mode {n}: every mass oscillates at the same frequency ω{n} = {w} rad/s and the shape never changes, it only grows and shrinks. Its profile changes sign {nodes} times.
presetInfo.exchange: Two equal masses joined by a weak spring. Push only the first: its energy slowly passes to the second and comes back, like a double pendulum. These are beats between the two modes.
presetInfo.pulse: Only the first block displaced. It is a mix of every mode: the disturbance travels along the chain, bounces off the walls and the energy spreads among the masses.
